title: vFlow: Visual Flow Cytometry & Immunofluorescence Analysis Tool
description: vFlow desktop gating and single-particle analysis. Candidate 4.4.3rc18 consolidates duplicate controls, introduces a compact gate list with a selected-gate editor, and preserves all analysis options. Includes RC17 interaction fixes and RC16 workspace integrity and recovery. Scientific algorithms and benchmark acquisitions are unchanged. See UI_CLEANUP_v4.4.3rc18.md for validation and platform limits.
